item.title: MJR Morning Brief — October 8, 2026
item.description:
From Media Jobs Report, here's your latest media industry update.
Skydance is adding some major names to its Board. Laurene Powell Jobs, former Activision CEO Bobby Kotick and Ynon Kreiz are joining as directors, while former UK Prime Minister Tony Blair will serve as an advisor. David Ellison remains Chairman and CEO as Skydance brings Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery together.
In media jobs, Saga Communications has promoted John Hakim to General Manager of Charleston Media Solutions. Hakim spent the past five years as Director of Sales and succeeds Paul O’Malley, who recently moved into Saga’s Senior Vice President of Revenue Development role. Hakim previously worked for Cox Media Group in Jacksonville.
Next, USA TODAY Sports and PlayVS are launching a National High School Esports Championship. Eight teams will compete in Madden NFL, Marvel Rivals and Rocket League beginning October 12, with the top two advancing to the championship December 11. The tournament will also produce an inaugural ALL-USA Esports Team.
In television news, The CMA is bringing together some of country music’s biggest stars for a live celebration of Dolly Parton. Carrie Underwood, Reba McEntire, Lainey Wilson, Brad Paisley and more will perform Oct. 21 on ABC and Disney+. Proceeds will benefit Dolly Parton’s Imagination Library.
On the TV side, Podtrac's September rankings are out. Crime Junkie remains America's top podcast, followed by The Daily, NPR News Now, Up First and Dateline NBC. iHeart Audience Network leads both the U.S. publisher ranking and Podtrac's global multi-channel podcast ranking.
In radio news, Lauren Alaina brought her new album Stages to Live With Kelly and Mark, performing “Never Been In Love.” The appearance comes as her Chase Matthew collaboration “All My Exes” enters the Top 5 at country radio. Alaina is currently headlining The Stages Tour, including a November 12 Ryman Auditorium debut.
From the radio side of the industry, Hubbard South Florida gave 20 students a behind-the-scenes look at radio broadcasting. The Home School Palm Beach dot com group toured the studios and met personalities from New Country 103.1 and X102.3 while learning how shows are produced and exploring potential careers in media.
And finally, Dick Clark’s New Year’s Rockin’ Eve is expanding to streaming. The 2027 celebration will air live on both ABC and Disney+ for the first time. Ryan Seacrest returns as host, with Druski in Chicago, Rita Ora in Times Square, and Julianne Hough and Rob Gronkowski in Las Vegas.
For more media news, the latest jobs, free media tools and more, log in to MediaJobsReport.com.
